meta_description:
3,393 likes, 259 comments - peyushbansal on August 14, 2026: "In 1947, we won our freedom.
But even today, millions of Indians can't see the flag they salute - simply because they've never had a pair of glasses.

This Independence Day, don't just celebrate freedom. Give it.

🇮🇳 Run or walk 20,000 steps in the next 2 days - Aug 15 & 16.

For every person who completes it, we donate a pair of glasses to someone in need.

Your steps 👣 Someone's sight. 👁️

Jai Hind 🫡🇮🇳

Tag one person you're running with. 👥
#RunForVision #DrishtiKiDaud".
